pour.c: Every day, new leads pour into your WhatsApp.

holes.c: But your bucket has holes, and leads leak out.

hole2.c: Hole 2: the follow-up you meant to send.
hole2.label: NO FOLLOW-UP

hole3.c: Hole 3: hot leads buried under hundreds of chats.
hole3.label: LOST LEAD

more.c: So you spend more on ads, and it leaks just as fast.

fix.c: Don't pour more. Fix the bucket.

patches.c: Patch 1: AI replies to every message, day or night.
Patch 2: follow-ups go out on their own.
Patch 3: a built-in CRM tags and tracks every lead.

stays.c: Now every lead stays, and turns into business.

same.c: Same leads. More bookings. No extra ad spend.

cta.c: Where is your bucket leaking? Comment LEAK.
cta.label: Comment below
